task: Make Lattice parallel merge guidance detect real active worktree file overlaps instead of relying only on manually declared sharedHotspots.
outcome: After running lattice parallel_merge_queue --storyIds=["B-a","B-b"] --format=json on two active story worktrees that both changed packages/main/src/core/example.ts, the terminal JSON shows each story degraded from parallel_dev, lists the overlapping file packages/main/src/core/example.ts with the peer story id, keeps authority.productionDone=false, and tells the operator not to run simultaneous DEV or merge blindly.
facts: Parallel Wave is L0/read-only planning guidance, not gate evidence or Authority proof.
Current sharedHotspots detection depends on story metadata and misses actual git diff overlaps when hotspots are not declared.
Story owner lease protects story-scoped metadata writes but does not prevent two different story worktrees from editing the same source file.
Main write lock serializes shared writes and DONE merge, but it does not schedule active worktree file overlap before merge.
Material overlap detection will use git-derived changed paths and ignore Lattice runtime/story metadata paths such as .lattice/**, .koala/**, .omx/**, owner-lease/runtime/cache/log artifacts.
constraints: Do not add a broad global file lock.
Do not mutate story metadata from parallel_wave/parallel_merge_queue commands except optional no-overwrite output artifact requested by caller.
Only use git-derived overlap as local Non-authority scheduling guidance.
Do not claim productionDone, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, or receipt verification.
Ignore Lattice runtime/story metadata and non-material runtime artifacts in changed-file overlap checks.
